recognize_zh: CD20 染色下整片細胞幾乎都是藍色陰性，只有約 4–5 個散在的小圓細胞呈深棕色陽性，是殘存的正常 B 細胞；骨髓瘤漿細胞通常 CD20 陰性，因此這種「背景幾乎全陰」的樣式符合漿細胞腫瘤。
features: IHC for CD20 on a densely cellular marrow core
Only rare (about 4–5) scattered small round cells with strong membranous/cytoplasmic brown staining
Positive cells are small and dispersed, not forming aggregates or nodules
Vast majority of cells, including the infiltrating population, are CD20 negative
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD20 on the bone marrow trephine shows only rare, scattered small CD20-positive cells consistent with residual normal B lymphocytes. The densely cellular infiltrate is CD20 negative, and no B-cell aggregates or sheets are identified. Lack of CD20 expression by the infiltrating cells argues against a B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation, and findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma in conjunction with CD138 and light chain studies.

ddx.vs: LPL contains a CD20-positive small B-cell component admixed with plasma cells, whereas here CD20-positive cells are only rare and scattered.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: MZL shows CD20-positive B-cell nodules or interstitial infiltrates alongside the plasma cells, which are absent here.

ddx.dx: CD20-positive plasma cell myeloma (often with t(11;14))
ddx.vs: A minority of myelomas express CD20 on the plasma cells themselves, which would give diffuse staining of the infiltrate rather than rare scattered cells.
